items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Eridanus fork of the shadcn base-rhea input, installed in place of it at components/ui/input.tsx. Focus and errors show on the border alone: no focus ring; at rest a muted-foreground border at 70%, 3:1 against the page in both themes so the field's edge meets WCAG 1.4.11, and a foreground border on focus and a solid destructive border when invalid. Same API as shadcn's. The field is a pill, with its text 12px in to line up with a Select's value.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Eridanus fork of the shadcn base-rhea textarea, installed in place of it at components/ui/textarea.tsx. Focus and errors show on the border alone: no focus ring; at rest a muted-foreground border at 70%, 3:1 against the page in both themes so the field's edge meets WCAG 1.4.11, and a foreground border on focus and a solid destructive border when invalid. Same API as shadcn's. Its corners are 16px, the same as a multi-line input group.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Eridanus fork of the shadcn base-rhea select, installed in place of it at components/ui/select.tsx. Focus and errors show on the border alone: no focus ring; at rest a muted-foreground border at 70%, 3:1 against the page in both themes so the field's edge meets WCAG 1.4.11, and a foreground border on focus and a solid destructive border when invalid. The popup pads its list so the selected option lands on the value, grows to fit its longest option, and highlights options as pills inside concentric corners; the trigger is a pill too. Same API as shadcn's.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Eridanus fork of the shadcn base-rhea input group, installed in place of it at components/ui/input-group.tsx, on the forked input and textarea. Focus and errors show on the border alone: no focus ring; at rest a muted-foreground border at 70%, 3:1 against the page in both themes so the field's edge meets WCAG 1.4.11, and a foreground border on focus and a solid destructive border when invalid. Same API as shadcn's. Its corners are 16px, a pill at the single-line height, with pill buttons inside.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Eridanus fork of the shadcn base-rhea dropdown menu, installed in place of it at components/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx. The highlighted item is a pill and the popup's corners stay concentric with it (16px pill radius plus the 4px list padding), matching Select and Combobox. Same API as shadcn's.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Eridanus fork of the shadcn base-rhea combobox, installed in place of it at components/ui/combobox.tsx. The highlighted option is a pill and the popup's corners stay concentric with it (16px pill radius plus the 4px list padding), matching Select and Dropdown Menu. Same API as shadcn's. The chips field has 16px corners (a pill on one line) and pill chips.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Eridanus fork of the shadcn base-rhea button, installed in place of it at components/ui/button.tsx. Every size is a pill and icon sizes are circles, matching the fields and the Select trigger. Same API as shadcn's.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Eridanus fork of the shadcn base-rhea toggle, installed in place of it at components/ui/toggle.tsx. It is a pill, like Button. Same API as shadcn's.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Eridanus fork of the shadcn base-rhea toggle group, installed in place of it at components/ui/toggle-group.tsx. Items are pills; a joined horizontal group is one pill, and a joined vertical group has 16px outer corners. Same API as shadcn's.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Eridanus fork of the shadcn base-rhea badge, installed in place of it at components/ui/badge.tsx. It is a pill, like Button. Same API as shadcn's.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Eridanus fork of the shadcn base-rhea field, installed in place of it at components/ui/field.tsx. Stacked, a field's label, control, description and error sit 8px apart instead of 12, so the label reads as its control's heading and fields (24px apart in a FieldGroup) stand clearly apart; side by side they keep 12px. Same API as shadcn's.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Eridanus fork of the shadcn base-rhea tabs, installed in place of it at components/ui/tabs.tsx. The default list is a pill with pill triggers (16px corners when vertical); the line variant is unchanged. Same API as shadcn's.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Eridanus fork of the shadcn base-rhea command, installed in place of it at components/ui/command.tsx. Items highlight as pills inside 20px corners, matching the dropdowns. Same API as shadcn's.
